messages:
Aria V: FYI — scheduling a small SDK change to emit a compact routing/quota shim header behind a flag to help the console reconcile attributions during the routing header migration. Goal: non-breaking, tiny, redactable.

Omar D: Can you share the proposed header? need to check browser/proxy size limits.

Aria V: Compact form proposal:
X-RW-S: svc=payments;rh=0x2c
X-RW-Q: b=def;t=sha256:3d5f2a (salted+truncated)
Only emitted when client opts in. No behavior change to routing if header absent.

Keiko N: Console will accept both this shim and legacy routehint for 60 days. We'll store t as tenant_hash and document salt rotation. Add a dashboard tile showing "attributed % by header_type".

Tom S: In Python/TS/Go SDKs we'll add client.enable_routing_shim (default false). Important: redaction must be baked into our logging util so these headers never show up in error breadcrumbs.

Omar D: Also ensure async streaming calls are unaffected. Hash computation should be tiny and sync. For Node browsers, watch CORS and header size — keep header < 256 bytes.

Keiko N: Telemetry plan: samples tagged header_type=shim|legacy. We'll add metric route.header.migration_rate and a small alert if mismatch rate spikes >5%.

Aria V: Suggested timeline:
- Day 0: SDK flags land (minor semver, changelog) + redaction util update
- Day 1: internal staging toggle + Console accepts both shapes
- Day 3: 1% canary with obs monitoring
- Day 10: enable default for new installs; keep legacy mapping for 60 days

Tom S: Tests: unit tests for header emission, redaction tests asserting sanitized logs contain no tenant substrings, integration test against staging ingest. We'll also add e2e that simulates a billing dispute mapping a hash back using console salt (console-only operation).

Omar D: Semver note: adding an opt-in flag is a minor bump, but redaction util change could be a patch. Make sure changelog clearly states "no protocol behavioral change unless opt-in".

Keiko N: Console UX will have a short explainer in the rollout tile about what truncated hashes mean and how legal/billing teams can request a salt unlock to map hashes for disputes. That will be gated.

Aria V: Ops: oncall-bot, can you create an alert for any trace containing plaintext "tenant=" or header names?

oncall-bot: created alert "shim_cleartext_tenant_detected" -> assigned to #devex-oncall.

sdk-bot: created RW-7550 "compact routing shim: SDK opt-in flags + console mapping" and linked owners.

Tom S: Small implementation snippet for Python request builder:
```py
if client.opts.enable_routing_shim and not headers.get('X-RW-S'):
    headers['X-RW-S'] = format_route_short(route)
    headers['X-RW-Q'] = make_meta(tenant_id, salt)  # returns truncated sha
```
We'll ensure headers are redacted in exception formatting util.

Omar D: For TS SDK add a server-side feature flag path too (for customers who want centralized rollout). Document both paths.

Keiko N: We'll accept both header forms for 60 days and emit migration metrics. Please include a one-page migration playbook in the PR with query samples to reconcile legacy vs shim attribution.

Aria V: Thanks — Tom, Omar, Keiko: can you have PRs + playbook drafts by EOD tomorrow? Oncall will monitor canary; if any cleartext tenant appears we abort. Tag me on PRs. :white_check_mark:
